text_block_list.text:
One day, having finished the preparations for the special race,
Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide were looking out over the track together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...The course is finalized,
and we have an estimate of the spectator count. All that's left...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is deciding the runners...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Given that it's for the Appreciation Festival,
a mediocre lineup is out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The ultimate matchup that the audience desires, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Following that logic,
something like a showdown between Teio and McQueen comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A clash between an unprecedented genius and the prodigy of an illustrious bloodline
would certainly draw immense attention.
As for other plausible combinations...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A battle at the summit featuring
the "Emperor," Symboli Rudolf, and someone of equal stature.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pitting her against Maruzensky, perhaps.
Or maybe a Triple Crown duel.
A dream matchup against Mr. C.B.—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Once I start brainstorming, there is no end to it.
Do you have anything in mind?
Any idea of the ultimate card the audience would want to see?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There's one single matchup that comes to mind.
One that's tailor-made for this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Tailor-made"...?
Which matchup could that possibly be...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Is that prized brain of yours taking a break?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Who is standing right here right now?
Just regular horse girls? Or...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You can't mean—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Finally realized it?
That's right—a clash between the strongest sisters.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...!?
You intend to settle things with me here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Deciding the ultimate victor can wait for down the road,
but testing our strength against each other right now isn't a bad idea, is it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The showdown everyone desires... Come to think of it, you're right.
Indeed, that should have been the first thing to cross my mind...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it... Perhaps I was intentionally
trying not to think about it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So, what'll it be, Sis...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is there even a need to ask?
My answer was decided long ago.
And then came the day of the special race—
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!）

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah. An attendance beyond expectations...
It seems I miscalculated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That just shows how much the crowd
is anticipating our race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...So, how are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
With you standing beside me, my resolve doesn't waver in the slightest.
I'm in top condition. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It'd be a lie to say nothing's changed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But it's a change for the better.
I smashed through countless walls, learned pain,
and now I'm standing right here. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I'm glad to hear you're in good shape.
Though honestly, it would be troublesome if you weren't.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The answer is simple.
My formula for victory is formulated entirely on the premise
that you are at your absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Keep talking.
I'll tear that formula of yours to shreds!!
(CLACK!)
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!）

The race that unfolded—became a magnificent contest
vividly etched into the memories of everyone who watched.
